title: Glorch
description: Share ender chest inventories with friends! Made for Folia
body:
# Glorch

Ever wanted a quick way to transport items to your friend on the other side of your server? This plugin lets you do exactly that and more! Players can create a joint ender chest inventory with another player using one simple command.

This plugin is tested on Folia, a multi-threaded Paper fork.

I am writing this from scratch with no usage of AI whatsoever.

## Installation

Download the .jar file here, or pick it up at [git.capyfro.dev](https://git.capyfro.dev/daniel/Glorch/releases). The .jar file goes in your server's plugin folder.

## Usage

```
/glorch <add|delete|accept> <player>
```

## Contributing
